title: Legacy pre-flag queued prompts in sessions that never had Engram load as Ambiguous instead of runnable
outcome: A queued prompt saved before the promotion-disposition marker existed, in a session that never had Engram, loads after a restart as runnable ordinary input in its FIFO position, while unknown-disposition entries in sessions with any Engram footprint stay Ambiguous and are never replayed.
acceptance: Legacy pre-flag queued prompts in sessions that never had Engram load as Ambiguous instead of runnable is done
